review.tenable.tenableio.is.a.cloud-base: Tenable.io is a cloud-based vulnerability management platform from the makers of Nessus, the world's most widely deployed vulnerability scanner. It provides comprehensive visibility into vulnerabilities across IT, cloud, and OT environments.
review.tenable.the.vulnerability.priorit: The Vulnerability Priority Rating (VPR) uses machine learning to analyze threat intelligence, exploit availability, and real-world attack data to prioritize vulnerabilities that pose actual risk—not just high CVSS scores.
Tenable.io's asset-centric approach provides continuous visibility into the attack surface, helping organizations understand what's exposed and where to focus remediation efforts.
review.tenable.ai-powered.prioritization: AI-powered prioritization based on real-world threat data and exploitability.
review.tenable.continuous.asset.discover: Continuous asset discovery and inventory across all environments.
review.tenable.native.scanning.for.aws.a: Native scanning for AWS, Azure, GCP cloud configurations.
review.tenable.dast.scanning.for.web.app: DAST scanning for web application vulnerabilities.
review.tenable.audit.configurations.agai: Audit configurations against CIS benchmarks and regulatory requirements.
Enterprise pricing based on deployment scale and features:
review.tenable.custom.pricing.based.on.o: Custom pricing based on organization size
review.tenable.tenable.certifications.va: Tenable certifications validate proficiency with Nessus vulnerability scanning and Tenable.io cloud-based vulnerability management. These credentials demonstrate expertise in continuous exposure management.
review.tenable.deploy.nessus.scanners.co: Deploy Nessus scanners, configure credentialed scans, analyze vulnerability data, and generate compliance reports.
